capabilities: Rank notes related to the open note by vocabulary overlap, flagging unlinked ones
Find near-duplicate notes, adoptable orphans, insubstantial links and broken links
Search the vault with ranked BM25 results and highlighted context
Inject wikilinks for mentioned but unlinked note titles, with a reviewable changes list
Chat with a locally running Silica agent that can read and edit notes
disambiguation: Not an AI plugin at its core; the analysis panel, search, autolink and graph run entirely offline without any language model.
extras: The chat panel only talks to a localhost WebSocket and never contacts remote hosts; the agent's model choice (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or hosted API) is configured on the Silica side. The agent wire contract is documented in PROTOCOL.md.
problem: Obsidian's search treats every hit equally, backlinks only show who linked here, and nothing surfaces near-duplicates, unlinked orphans or links that point to unrelated notes.

relations.evidence: for that half you need the Silica agent running on the same machine

summary: Vault-analysis panel that surfaces related notes, near-duplicates, adoptable orphans, weak and broken links, ranked BM25 search, autolinking and a community graph.
